T-136 stays in queue: the T-266 ripple asked for it to be unheld, and it already had been. The daily-output loop works on the simulator, but nothing on screen shows it yet, so the capture can't be done.

- **Timeline showing attended-day-N and output_delivered_dayN:** not done. There is no screen to capture:

  - The next pass needs one of two things built: a per-contact timeline page in `cloud/funnel/worker.js`, or the delivery sent through to the CRM. The guide's event names also need fixing to match. Another session has uncommitted edits open in `worker.js`, so I left that file alone.
